novel_features.name: Soonest-available barber across shops
novel_features.description: Find the barber who can cut your hair soonest across several shops, ranked by next open slot.
novel_features.rationale: Squire shows one shop at a time with no cross-shop availability view; this fetches live next-available-time across N shops and sorts ascending.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Reach for this when the user wants the earliest appointment and doesn't care which shop — the website cannot answer this.

novel_features.name: Cross-shop compare
novel_features.description: Put two or more named shops side by side on average price, rating, review count, and staff size.
novel_features.rationale: Requires a local join across mirrored services, reviews, and shops that the API only exposes per-shop.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use when the user has specific shops in mind and wants a head-to-head; not for ranking an unknown set.

novel_features.name: Cheapest service in an area
novel_features.description: Rank shops by the lowest price for one service category (e.g. Haircut) across a city or near a shop.
novel_features.rationale: Local FTS over service name/category plus a sort on integer-cent cost across shops; the site has no price sort or cross-shop view.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use when price is the deciding factor for a single service the user wants.

novel_features.name: Watch a shop for drift
novel_features.description: Snapshot a shop's prices, staff, and rating; on re-run, diff against the last snapshot and show what changed.
novel_features.rationale: Stateful over-time snapshot diff is impossible on the stateless website; powered by the local SQLite mirror.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use to detect cents-level price moves, added/removed barbers, or rating shifts at one shop over time.

novel_features.name: City shop ranking by rating confidence
novel_features.description: Rank the best shops in a city by rating weighted by review volume, with Squire's AI review summary attached.
novel_features.rationale: Confidence-weighted ranking (rating x log(reviews)) across mirrored shops; AI summary is passed through verbatim, no LLM.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use when relocating or exploring a new area and you want quality-ranked shops in one view.

narrative.headline: Every barbershop on Squire, queryable from the terminal — cross-shop price compare, soonest-available barber, and review rankings the website never built.
narrative.value_prop: squire-pp-cli mirrors Squire's barbershop discovery API into a local SQLite store so you can do what getsquire.com cannot: compare named shops side by side, find the cheapest haircut in a city, rank shops by rating confidence, and watch a shop for price or staff drift. All read-only, no account required.

quickstart.comment: Confirm the CLI is wired up and the API is reachable (no auth needed).
Put two shops head to head on price, rating, and staff (live; no sync needed).
Rank a shop's barbers by their next open slot.
Find the cheapest haircut-category service across the given shops.

troubleshoots.symptom: A services command returns 500 'invalid input syntax for type uuid'
troubleshoots.fix: Pass the shop UUID, not the slug, to service commands; run 'squire-pp-cli resolve <slug>' to get the UUID (or use the slug-aware compound commands which resolve it for you).
The compound commands (compare/soonest/cheapest/roster) are live and need no sync; ensure the shop slug or UUID is correct (try 'squire-pp-cli directory list-public --term <name>').
Reviews paginate via --limit and --skip; raise --limit or page with --skip.

narrative.when_to_use: Use squire-pp-cli when you need to compare barbershops on Squire across price, rating, staff, or availability — tasks the website only answers one shop at a time. It is ideal for finding the soonest appointment across shops, the cheapest service in a city, or auditing a shop's listing against competitors over time.
anti_triggers: Do not use this CLI to book or pay for an appointment — it is read-only and unauthenticated.
Do not use it for non-Squire barbershops or salons on other platforms (Booksy, Fresha, Vagaro).
Do not use it to manage a shop's own bookings or staff — that is the Squire Commander app's job.
